description: This file contains unit tests for the CordRepBtree class in the Abseil library, testing various aspects such as creation, validation, merging, subtree extraction, and buffer operations.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeTestPeer
classes.description: Helper class to access private members of CordRepBtree for testing purposes.

classes.name: DataConsumer
classes.description: Helper class to consume string data in tests, either forward or backward.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for testing CordRepBtree with shared or private configurations.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeHeightTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for testing CordRepBtree with different heights.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeDualTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for testing CordRepBtree with combinations of shared/private trees.

methods.name: MakeHexFlat
methods.description: Creates a flat representation with hexadecimal string of an index, zero-padded to 4 digits.

methods.name: MakeLeaf
methods.description: Creates a leaf node with a specified size, defaulting to maximum capacity.

methods.name: MakeTree
methods.description: Creates a tree with a specified size, either appending or prepending flats.

methods.name: CreateTree
methods.description: Creates a tree from a span of CordRep pointers.

methods.name: CreateTreeReverse
methods.description: Creates a tree from a string by creating flats and prepending in reverse order.

methods.name: RefEdgesAt
methods.description: Recursively references edges at a specified depth in the tree.

methods.name: ExtractLast
methods.description: Helper to extract the last buffer from a tree, used in tests.
